also_copied_to: models/exotic/sigreg_seed42.pt (the training command's own output path, same sha256)

training.command: uv run inmotion train exotic --model sigreg --data data/processed/dataset.csv --seed 42 --d-model 192 --num-layers 3 --latent-dim 128

notes: Chosen on best validation MCC only; the test MCC above was not used for selection.
The --d-model 192 --num-layers 3 flags matter: the entry point maps d_model to num_filters and num_layers to num_blocks for sigreg, and the CLI defaults (256/4) would build a different architecture.

Same architecture as the superseded backup/sigreg_seed42.pt (registry name sigreg_icaisf): identical state_dict keys and shapes (62 tensors, 696,900 parameters), so the Rust port and its parity goldens stay valid in shape; only the weights differ.
The superseded checkpoint remains registered and on disk because MASTER_RESULTS.md section 2.3 cites it.
